highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with variable fonts and animated WebP support.
highlights_body: It bumps through Skia milestones 132-148, adds variable font and color-font-palette support, animated WebP encoding, and native dependency refreshes across freetype, harfbuzz, libpng, zlib, and expat. This is a breaking release — check the changes below before upgrading, especially if you use Vulkan or rely on default-typeface null checks.

breaking.title: new SKFont() now has an empty typeface, not a lazy default
breaking.body: Upstream removed the lazy default-typeface resolution. new SKFont().Typeface is now SKTypeface.Empty (0 glyphs) instead of null, so MeasureText returns 0 until you set a real typeface. Construct with new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default) explicitly, and detect "unset" with Typeface.IsEmpty instead of a null check.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface now returns SKTypeface.Default, not null
breaking.body: SkiaSharp seeds a usable default font so text still works, but paint.Typeface == null no longer detects "no typeface set". Use paint.Typeface.IsEmpty instead, or drop the check.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName("missing") returns Default instead of null on Android
breaking.body: All platforms are now consistent: an unknown family returns SKTypeface.Default rather than null. For a strict "was it actually found?" check, call SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name), which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.Default is now guaranteed non-null
breaking.body: Default resolution moved to the font manager. Behavior is unchanged on macOS/Windows/Linux; Android API 36+ now falls back to SKTypeface.Empty instead of crashing.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws and is obsolete
breaking.body: The overload used to silently truncate offsets beyond int range; it's now [Obsolete] and throws OverflowException for out-of-range values. Call Move(int) with an in-range, pre-validated offset.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1 and calls SK_ABORT (unrecoverable process termination, not an exception) if the minimum isn't met. Declare VK_API_VERSION_1_1 in both your VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion and GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion (do not leave MaxAPIVersion at its default 0). Hardware that is genuinely Vulkan-1.0-only can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan and must fall back to raster or another backend.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed. Delete those assignments; use fVkExtensions in place of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 in place of fFeatures. There is no replacement for fOwnsInstanceAndDevice.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped, and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value-equality
breaking.body: The property is now GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo (adding a new Components field), and the old GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo no longer implements IEquatable or the equality operators. Update code that compared instances with == or Equals.

breaking.title: Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs promoted to compile errors
breaking.body: Legacy SKPaint text/font state-reading members and other pre-v4 obsoletes are now compile errors instead of warnings, and obsolete enum members were trimmed from the reference assembly. Migrate to the SKFont-based APIs called out in the obsolete messages.

bullets.detail: Steps the bundled Skia engine forward across five milestones to m148, merging multiple rounds of upstream chrome/m147 bug fixes along the way.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, adds color font palette support, and improves variable font robustness overall.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream access
bullets.detail: Adds SKWebpEncoder support for animated WebP output and a zero-copy SKStream.GetData() for turning a stream directly into an SKData.

bullets.lead: GPU sampling and color API additions
bullets.detail: Adds SKSamplingOptions support to SKSurface.Draw/SKCanvas.DrawSurface, a new HBColor struct for hb_color_t, and fills in missing API wrappers while fixing naming-convention violations.

bullets.lead: Pixel access stride and offset fixes
bullets.detail: Fixes SKPixmap/SKBitmap GetPixelSpan to use RowBytes for stride, and fixes the GetPixelSpan<T>(x,y) offset calculation, which was using Height instead of Width.
Fixes a crash when an SKPathBuilder is garbage-collected before the SKPath it built, and fixes the WinUI Projection DLL not being found by .NET 9 consumers.
Fixes SKGLView not rendering again after switching MAUI TabBar tabs on Android.

Reworks how SkiaSharp's singleton instances are created and torn down, and moves the native-compatibility gate from a module initializer into the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup ordering.

bullets.lead: Apple TFM and native-asset platform support
bullets.detail: Fixes Apple platform TFMs (26.0 for libraries, unversioned for apps), adds Tizen x64/arm64 and Linux Bionic native asset support, and drops native builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten/WASM.
Updates freetype, harfbuzz, libjpeg-turbo, libpng, zlib, and expat to their latest maintained versions across this line.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Drove the v4 default-typeface rework, variable font and animated WebP work, the SKPath finalizer fix, and the singleton lifecycle rework.
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Added Linux Bionic native assets and PolySharp-based C# 13 support for legacy TFMs.
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Contributed a fix landed in this release line.
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Contributed a fix landed in this release line.
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch on Android.

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Opened the v4 line with the Skia milestone 132/147 bumps, variable font support, and the default-typeface managed-layer rework.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Added animated WebP encoding, zero-copy stream-to-data conversion, and TreatWarningsAsErrors cleanup across the binding.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Reworked the singleton instance lifecycle and refreshed bundled native dependencies (freetype, harfbuzz, libjpeg-turbo, libpng, zlib, expat).
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Finished v4 stabilization: pixel-access stride fixes, remaining obsolete APIs promoted to errors, and the final Skia m148 sync ahead of release.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates HarfBuzzSharp to 14.2.0 alongside the variable font and color-font-palette work, adding the new HBColor struct for hb_color_t.
